## Requirements checklist

- [ ] The tool is **free to use** (if it has paid tiers or a restrictive license, I noted that in the description)
- [ ] It has a **valid GitHub repo with the actual source code** (not a pseudo repo that only holds a README, releases, or links)
- [ ] It is **not a duplicate** of an existing entry
- [ ] I added it to the **most fitting category**
- [ ] The description is **concise and accurate**, and follows the format of the surrounding entries
- [ ] If this is **my own project**, it has **50+ stars** (below that it counts as advertising)
- [ ] If this is an archived or unmaintained project (no updates in 2+ years), it belongs under **Archived Projects** and includes the "Last updated" date
